associates.clause: Specified Persons must make their Associates aware of the requirements of this Policy and take reasonable steps to ensure their Associates comply with those requirements.
associates.reasoning: Associate is defined to include a spouse, dependent children, a co-resident relative, and companies, trusts or partnerships the Specified Person controls or significantly influences, and the hedging, trading window, margin loan and stock lending rules are all expressed to bind Specified Persons' Associates equally.

tiers.tier_name: All full-time, part-time and casual employees, contractors, secondees, and directors of CBA and its subsidiaries

findings.question: cash_hedge
findings.clause: Insider Trading is prohibited in all circumstances, whether in relation to Group Securities or other Securities, regardless of any Pre-Clearance, exception or other provision of this Policy.
findings.reasoning: The hedging bans in paragraphs 8 and 9 bind only Specified Persons and, for vested shares specifically, only CBA Board directors, Group Company Secretaries and Group Executives; ordinary employees, contractors and secondees are bound only by the blanket insider trading prohibition, so a cash-settled hedge over vested shares is unaddressed for them.

findings.question: physical_hedge
findings.clause: Insider Trading is prohibited in all circumstances, whether in relation to Group Securities or other Securities, regardless of any Pre-Clearance, exception or other provision of this Policy.
findings.reasoning: The same hedging bans, which would catch either settlement method, do not extend to the general workforce, so a physically settled hedge over vested shares is unaddressed for ordinary employees, contractors and secondees.

findings.question: encumber
findings.clause: Insider Trading is prohibited in all circumstances, whether in relation to Group Securities or other Securities, regardless of any Pre-Clearance, exception or other provision of this Policy.
findings.reasoning: The prohibition on using Group Securities as security for margin lending or other secured financing binds only Specified Persons and their Associates, so pledging vested shares is unaddressed for the wider workforce.

findings.question: borrow_against_stock
findings.clause: Insider Trading is prohibited in all circumstances, whether in relation to Group Securities or other Securities, regardless of any Pre-Clearance, exception or other provision of this Policy.
findings.reasoning: The margin lending and secured-financing ban in paragraph 16(a) is expressly confined to Specified Persons and their Associates, leaving ordinary employees, contractors and secondees unaddressed.

findings.question: borrow_against_derivative
findings.clause: Insider Trading is prohibited in all circumstances, whether in relation to Group Securities or other Securities, regardless of any Pre-Clearance, exception or other provision of this Policy.
findings.reasoning: No provision addresses financing secured on a derivative rather than on Group Securities themselves, and in any event the wider workforce sits outside the Specified Person regime altogether.

findings.question: stock_loan
findings.clause: Insider Trading is prohibited in all circumstances, whether in relation to Group Securities or other Securities, regardless of any Pre-Clearance, exception or other provision of this Policy.
findings.reasoning: The stock lending ban in paragraph 16(c) is expressly confined to Specified Persons and their Associates, so lending vested shares is unaddressed for the general workforce.

findings.question: lender_enforcement
findings.clause: Insider Trading is prohibited in all circumstances, whether in relation to Group Securities or other Securities, regardless of any Pre-Clearance, exception or other provision of this Policy.
findings.reasoning: The forced-sale/breach language in paragraph 16(a) and the Trading Window exception process both apply only to Specified Persons, so a lender's enforcement sale is unaddressed for the general workforce.

tiers.tier_name: CBA Board directors, Group Company Secretaries and Group Executives

findings.question: cash_hedge
findings.clause: In addition, the CBA Board directors, Group Company Secretaries, Group Executives, and each of their Associates, must not enter into a transaction that limits the economic risk of their exposure to any vested Group Securities.
findings.reasoning: Unlike the narrower unvested/locked-only ban that binds all Specified Persons, paragraph 9 imposes an outright ban on this tier entering any transaction that limits the economic risk of a vested holding, which directly covers a cash-settled collar, put or swap.

findings.question: physical_hedge
findings.clause: In addition, the CBA Board directors, Group Company Secretaries, Group Executives, and each of their Associates, must not enter into a transaction that limits the economic risk of their exposure to any vested Group Securities.
findings.reasoning: A hedging ban framed as limiting economic risk catches both cash and physically settled structures, so a physically settled collar or put over vested Group Securities is equally banned for this tier.

findings.question: encumber
findings.clause: use Group Securities as security for margin lending or other secured financing arrangements, as a forced sale may lead to the breach of this Policy
findings.reasoning: This tier, as Specified Persons, is expressly banned from using Group Securities as security for margin lending or any other secured financing arrangement, which covers pledging or mortgaging vested shares.

findings.question: borrow_against_stock
findings.clause: use Group Securities as security for margin lending or other secured financing arrangements, as a forced sale may lead to the breach of this Policy
findings.reasoning: The same clause expressly bans using Group Securities as security for margin lending or other secured financing, directly prohibiting a margin loan or similar borrowing secured on vested shares.

findings.question: borrow_against_derivative
findings.clause: use Group Securities as security for margin lending or other secured financing arrangements, as a forced sale may lead to the breach of this Policy
findings.reasoning: Group Security is defined as a security issued by a Group member, so a bank-issued derivative such as a collar or put is not itself a Group Security; the ban only reaches financing secured on Group Securities themselves, leaving a loan secured on a derivative unaddressed.

findings.question: stock_loan
findings.clause: enter into contracts for difference or use any instruments or enter any arrangements for short selling or stock lending of Group Securities, except to the extent covered by any of the “Exceptions to Trading Windows” in this Policy.
findings.reasoning: Stock lending of Group Securities is expressly named and banned outright for this tier, subject only to the narrow, listed Trading Window exceptions, none of which covers a securities loan.

findings.question: lender_enforcement
findings.clause: use Group Securities as security for margin lending or other secured financing arrangements, as a forced sale may lead to the breach of this Policy
findings.reasoning: The clause expressly states that a forced sale arising from secured financing may itself amount to a breach of the Policy, so this tier is banned from a lender's enforcement sale rather than merely needing clearance for one.
